args.curatorialNote: Hokusai's iconic woodblock print, "The Great Wave off Kanagawa," captures the immense power of nature. Part of the "Thirty-six Views of Mount Fuji" series, it masterfully uses Prussian blue to depict a monstrous wave threatening boats, with Mount Fuji serene in the distance. This dynamic composition symbolizes humanity's fragile existence against nature's might, a timeless meditation on transience and awe.
